# Contributing to contrail-detect

This is version 1.13.1 of `contrail-detect`, the code used for Itcovitz et al. (in prep.).
This frozen snapshot will not be developed further here, as its functionality is being
integrated into [pycontrails](https://github.com/contrailcirrus/pycontrails), and so it does
not accept pull requests. Bug reports and questions are nevertheless welcome, and may be
carried forward in pycontrails.

## Questions

Please ask questions about using the code or the method in
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/itcojo/contrail-detect/discussions), rather than
opening an issue.

## Bug reports

Please open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/itcojo/contrail-detect/issues) that includes
a minimal example reproducing the problem, your Python version and operating system, and
whether you installed the `[local]` extra.

## Security

To report a security vulnerability, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
